Balkrishna Industries manufactures off-highway tyres used in specialist segmentations like [[mining]], [[earthmoving]], [[agriculture]], and [[gardening]] in five factories located in [[Aurangabad, Maharashtra|Aurangabad]], [[Bhiwadi]], Chopanki, [[Dombivali]], and [[Bhuj]]. In 2013, it was ranked 41st among the world's tyre makers.{{Cite news|url=http://www.tirebusiness.com/article/20141030/NEWS/141039992/bkt-opens-1st-u-s-warehouse|title=BKT opens 1st U.S. warehouse – Tire Business|work=Tire Business|access-date=24 January 2018}} BKT sponsors various [[sport]]s competitions in several countries, most notably [[Monster Jam]].{{Cite web |last=Editors |first=Tyrepress |date=2014-03-04 |title=BKT the official tyre of Monster Jam |url=https://www.tyrepress.com/2014/03/bkt-the-official-tyre-of-monster-jam/ |access-date=2025-05-02 |website=Tyrepress |language=en-GB}} [[File:EXCON 2025, Bangalore International Exhibition Centre (492).jpg|thumb|right|BKT at [[EXCON]] 2025, [[Bangalore International Exhibition Centre|BIEC]] ]] [[File:EXCON 2025, Bangalore International Exhibition Centre (495).jpg|thumb|right|A BKT tyre at display in EXCON 2025, BIEC]] ==History== Balkrishna Industries began operations in the year 1987 with the inauguration of its first off-highway tyre manufacturing facility in [[Aurangabad]]. Subsequent growth in business allowed the company to open new facilities in Dubai (2002) and Chopanaki (2006). It also diversified its product line by introducing tyres for ATV, earthmoving and gardening vehicles. ==Operations== Balkrishna Industries is currently an [[OEM]] vendor for [[heavy equipment]] manufacturers like [[JCB (heavy equipment manufacturer)|JCB]], [[John Deere]], and [[CNH Industrial]]. In 2014, BKT held a 8% [[market share]] of the global off-the-road tyre segment.{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/articleshow/33526268.cms?intenttarget=no|title=What makes Balkrishna Industries confident of achieving higher market share amid competition from Michelin, Bridgestone, and Continental?|last=Shyam|first=Ashutosh R.|date=10 April 2014|work=The Economic Times|access-date=24 January 2018}} Balkrishna Industries predominantly caters to the replacement market in North America and Europe. Its North American office is located in [[Akron, Ohio]], with one warehouse in [[Wando, South Carolina]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.tyrepress.com/2014/12/bkt-investing-in-infrastructure-staff-in-north-america/|title=BKT investing in infrastructure, staff in North America|date=17 December 2014|work=Tyrepress|access-date=24 January 2018|language=en-US}} About 80 percent of Balkrishna Industries' business in the United States is in the farm market.{{Cite news|url=http://www.rubbernews.com/article/20130729/ISSUE/307299985/tire-veteran-casalbore-ready-for-challenge-at-bkt-usa|title=Tire veteran Casalbore ready for challenge at BKT USA - Rubber & Plastics News|last=McCarron|first=Kathy|work=Rubber & Plastics News|access-date=24 January 2018}} In 2025, it incorporated a subsidiary in the [[Netherlands]]. It also announced a five-year roadmap involving 400 million dollars in investment.{{Cite web |last=Stephen |date=2025-06-23 |title=BKT establishes Netherlands-based subsidiary |url=https://www.tyrepress.com/2025/06/bkt-establishes-netherlands-based-subsidiary/ |access-date=2025-09-19 |website=Tyrepress |language=en-GB}}{{Cite web |last=Awan |first=Zahra |date=2025-05-30 |title=BKT announces 2030 roadmap with US$400m in investments |url=https://www.tiretechnologyinternational.com/news/investments/bkt-announces-2030-roadmap-with-us400m-in-investments.html |access-date=2025-09-19 |website=Tire Technology International |language=en-GB}} ===Sponsorships=== [[File:BKT Tires Display Monster Truck 2024.jpg|thumb|right|A monster truck promoting BKT, the official tire of Monster Jam (2024)]] BKT Tires has been the official and exclusive tyre [[sponsor (commercial)|sponsor]] for [[Monster Jam]] (a competition involving [[monster truck]]s) since 2014.{{Cite news|url=https://www.tyrepress.com/2014/03/bkt-the-official-tyre-of-monster-jam/|title=BKT the official tyre of Monster Jam|date=4 March 2014|work=Tyrepress|access-date=24 January 2018|language=en-US}} In July 2018, BKT purchased naming rights for Italian football's second division, [[Serie B]] for three years, with the league being known as Serie BKT under the agreement.{{Cite web|url=https://www.calcioefinanza.it/2018/06/22/nuovo-title-sponsor-serie-b-bkt/|title=La B cambia nome: Si chiamerà Serie BKT fino al 2021|date=22 June 2018}} On 15 January 2020, BKT signed an agreement with [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|LFP]] to rename the French football second division as [[Ligue 2|Ligue 2 BKT]] for four years.{{Cite web|title=Accord majeur de naming entre la Ligue 2 et BKT|url=https://www.lfp.fr/Articles/COMMUNIQUÉS/2020/01/15/signature-d-un-accord-majeur-de-naming-entre-la-ligue-2-et-bkt|access-date=8 February 2021|website=LFP|date=15 January 2020 |language=fr-FR}} The sponsorship deal was extended until 2028.{{Cite web |date=14 June 2023 |title=BKT retains Ligue 2 naming rights |url=https://www.sportbusiness.com/news/bkt-retains-ligue-2-naming-rights/ |access-date=6 July 2023 |website=SportBusiness |language=en-US|url-access=subscription}} On 2 September 2022, BKT were announced as northern hemisphere title sponsorship for the [[United Rugby Championship]] for three years.{{Cite web |date=2 September 2022 |title=BKT Becomes United Rugby Championship Northern-Hemisphere Title Sponsor|url=https://www.unitedrugby.com/latest/news/bkt-becomes-united-rugby-championship-northern-hemisphere-title-sponsor |access-date=31 August 2023 |website=United Rugby Championship}}{{Cite web |date=2 September 2022 |title=United Rugby Championship lands BKT as northern-hemisphere title sponsor |url=https://www.sportbusiness.com/news/united-rugby-championship-lands-bkt-as-northern-hemisphere-title-sponsor/ |access-date=31 August 2023 |website=SportBusiness |language=en-US|url-access=subscription}} In cricket, BKT sponsored [[Kolkata Knight Riders]] in the [[2023 Indian Premier League]]. BKT has become the official title sponsor of [[EuroCup Basketball]] for 3 years{{Citation needed|date=June 2026}}.
